entries.title: Theme admin list showing Education.
entries.notes: Capture with Foundation Theme, Layout Builder, and capell-app/theme-education installed in the isolated demo harness.
entries.useCase: An administrator confirms the Education theme is available before applying it to a course or school site.

entries.title: Frontend page rendered with Education theme.
entries.notes: Capture a seeded learning-pathway page with navigation, hero, course catalogue, instructors, events, enrolment CTA, resources, FAQ, proof, CTA, and footer.
entries.useCase: A course provider sees how the theme connects discovery, trust, and enrolment in one public page.

entries.title: Education homepage.
entries.notes: Capture the pathway-led homepage with cohort proof, course cards, mentor signals, and enrolment actions.
entries.useCase: A school, academy, or training provider reviews the first-viewport learning journey before activating the theme.

entries.title: Course catalogue.
entries.notes: Capture course catalogue cards with learning outcomes, format markers, cohort readiness, and clear comparison rhythm.
entries.useCase: A learner compares course paths without the page feeling like a plain resource grid.

entries.title: Instructor and mentor profiles.
entries.notes: Capture instructor cards, teaching roles, mentor support copy, and learner-trust proof.
entries.useCase: A learner or parent can see who teaches the programme and why the team is credible.

entries.title: Open days and workshops.
entries.notes: Capture event cards using the static fallback or capell-app/events integration when installed.
entries.useCase: A school can promote open days, workshops, and cohort deadlines without custom Blade.

entries.title: Enrolment CTA.
entries.notes: Capture the enrolment path with steps, form-builder fallback state, and clear application actions.
entries.useCase: A training provider checks that the theme turns course interest into a confident application route.

entries.title: Learning resources.
entries.notes: Capture guide, worksheet, replay, and FAQ cards with the blog/resource integration fallback visible.
entries.useCase: A course provider reviews how support material stays tied to learning pathways instead of becoming a plain blog.

entries.title: Signed admin preview route.
entries.notes: Capture a signed preview URL generated for the seeded Education theme, site, and page.
entries.useCase: An administrator previews a course page with the Education theme applied before publishing the theme choice.
